project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions with withAuth() higher-order logic for atomic mutations + Zod + Audit Logs

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, contract_items, customers, leads, employees, audit_logs. Support: printing_orders, inventory_reservations, inventory_items, contract_notes, transaction_categories, studio_info, labs.
database_schema.strategy: ABC Framework — Group A (Keep ENUM), Group B (Rollback to VARCHAR+TS), Group C (Lookup Table)

new_tables.name: audit_logs
new_tables.description: Centralized system for tracking record changes (administered by lib/audit.ts)

design_system.description: Earth-tone luxury palette — Stripe-inspired, Apple HIG compliant

btn_architecture.note: All btn variants inherit base styles via CSS grouped selector. TSX can use btn-primary alone or btn btn-primary — both work.

components.UnifiedModal: Standard modal wrapper for all CRUD forms
components.ComboboxSearch: Searchable dropdown with Portal-based rendering for large lists
components.ScrollContainer: Context-based scroll tracking for elements inside overflow-hidden roots
components.StatusSelect: Interactive status dropdown with color-coded logic
components.SegmentedControl: Apple-style tabs for drawer navigation and filtered views
components.ErrorFallback: Clean module-specific error.tsx with SSOT styling
components.TableSuite: TableWrapper, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD (shared/table.tsx)

header_architecture.pattern: Merge order: props > context > defaults. rightSlot + titleOverride = mobile-only. Desktop keeps module defaults.

patterns.name: Searchable Combobox Pattern
patterns.details: Portal-based rendering to document.body + fixed positioning to escape modal overflow clipping.

patterns.name: ABC Schema Type Strategy
patterns.details: A (Keep ENUM — system), B (VARCHAR+TS — business logic), C (Lookup Table — user-managed)

patterns.name: VARCHAR + TS Enum Pattern (Group B)
patterns.details: DB: VARCHAR(N) | TS: const array + type [X] | Zod: z.enum() | SSOT map for labels

patterns.name: SSOT Enforcement Protocol
patterns.details: 1. REGISTRY.md quick-ref | 2. Mandatory AUTO-SCAN grep | 3. NEW TOKEN APPROVAL GATE (before-edit.md)

gotchas: Tailwind <table> border-collapse causes <th> to paint over <thead> background. Apply background directly to <tr>.
TW4 scans ALL files including .md — use @source not to exclude non-code dirs
TW4 syntax: rounded-[var(--token)] is WRONG → use rounded-sm/md/lg/xl directly
CSS btn variants must include base styles — dont rely on .btn being present
Header detail pages: use HeaderSlotsContext to set mobile header slots
PostgREST FK join: employees:created_by(full_name) FAILS if no FK — select UUID instead
File splitting: keep parent as orchestrator, extract child UI. NO internal barrel exports
Zod record lint: z.record() must have 2 args in current version: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())
Migration: Dependent partial indexes must be dropped before altering columns from ENUM to VARCHAR
AI-Drift Prevention: Always run 'AUTO-SCAN' grep commands and consult components/ui/REGISTRY.md BEFORE writing any UI code to ensure zero inline styles.

decisions.decision: Adopt ABC Framework for database schema types. Rolled back 12 business ENUMs to VARCHAR.
decisions.reason: Improves flexibility, avoids complex migrations for workflow changes, aligns with enterprise-grade modularity.

decisions.decision: Hybrid Gold Standard achieved: Audit Logs via fireAuditLog() + Zod server-side validation + error.tsx boundaries.
decisions.reason: Fixes 4 gaps identified during cross-module standardization audit (Phase A).

decisions.decision: Contract module = V2 Gold Standard. All future modules follow docs/specs/v2-module-template.md.
